F620
Product catalog summary
Overview
The F620 Leak Test Instrument is designed for industrial quality control across various sectors including automotive, domestic appliances, medical, aeronautic, defense, and packaging industries. It features a large color display, maximum performance, and multiple communication options.
Key Features
New electronic and measurement modules, interface, and accessories for improved quality control.
Fast and accurate leak testing cycle.
Pressure drop measurement with a range of up to 5000 Pa and high accuracy.
128 programmable settings with online configuration via USB.
Data storage on internal memory or USB key.
Supports multiple test modes including blockage, burst, and sealed components tests.
Technical Specifications
Physical dimensions: 250x150x360 mm, weight: 7 Kg.
Operating temperature: +5°C to +45°C, storage temperature: 0°C to +60°C.
Air supply: Clean and dry air, adhering to ISO 8573-1 standards.
Electrical supply: 24VDC/2A or 100-240VAC/50W.
Communication and Interface
Graphic color screen with intuitive menu-driven controls.
SMART KEY for programmable user functions.
Flexible communication formats including RS232, USB, and optional Fieldbus.
Options and Accessories
9 inputs/5 outputs compatible with 5 series instruments.
Electronic regulator, dual pressure, and automatic calibration check.
Memory card for archiving up to 1 million results.
Remote control options and various connectors available.
Environmental Compliance
Complies with ROHS standards.
